reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch equate Kings' "sons of Mahol" with Chronicles' "sons of Zerah" and treat the singer Heman, son of Joel, as a separate Levite figure.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells lists Mahol, Zerah, and Joel side by side as three flatly different fathers assigned to the one figure named Heman.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations round about.
